description: This file defines a sealed class `PdfPlaceholderObject` used for reserving space within a PDF stream, typically for digital signatures. It manages writing placeholder spaces and replacing them with actual objects, ensuring the space reservation is sufficient.

classes.name: PdfPlaceholderObject
classes.description: A sealed class for reserving and replacing space in a PDF stream, used for digital signatures or similar purposes. It manages placeholder space and ensures it is appropriately replaced with the actual object.

methods.name: WriteObject
methods.description: Writes spaces as a placeholder in the PDF stream to reserve space for the object.

methods.name: WriteActualObject
methods.description: Replaces the placeholder with the actual PDF object, ensuring the space reserved is sufficient.
